t: This is Battersea Power Station, a preserved coal-fired power station on the south bank of the Thames in Nine Elms. It's one of the world's largest brick buildings, and it's notable for its original Art Deco interior fittings and decor. It's now a shopping centre. The engineers were Leonard Pearce and CS Allott and Son, and the architects were J. Theo Halliday and Giles Gilbert Scott. Scott is also known for Liverpool Cathedral and the iconic red telephone box, so he designed both a cathedral and a power station.
